verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a general agent platform: YAML-configured agents, models, MCP and custom tools, skills, subagents and connected machines. Nothing in the evidence shows its agents implementing a requested feature end-to-end or writing tests. Community mentions of running Claude Code from a phone describe a third-party coding agent accessed through Omnara, not Omnara's own documented implementation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests
